name: MMA-ASIA
description: Large language models (LLMs) are now used worldwide, yet their multimodal understanding and reasoning often degrade outside Western, high-resource settings. We propose MMA-ASIA, a comprehensive framework to evaluate LLMs' cultural awareness with a focus on Asian contexts. MMA-ASIA centers on a human-curated, multilingual, and multimodally aligned multiple-choice benchmark covering 8 Asian countries and 10 languages, comprising 27,000 questions; over 79 percent require multi-step reasoning grounded in cultural context, moving beyond simple memorization. To our knowledge, this is the first dataset aligned at the input level across three modalities: text, image (visual question answering), and speech. This enables direct tests of cross-modal transfer. reputation: A very recent benchmark aimed at cultural and multimodal evaluation in Asian contexts, with early-stage adoption so far.
notes: Multilingual and multimodal; many questions require multi-step cultural reasoning, and the benchmark is new so contamination and leaderboard maturity are limited.
